name: vllm_grouped_topk
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_grouped_topk.py. Grouped top-k MoE routing: scores (num_tokens, total_experts) randn, bias (total_experts,) randn, with scalar num_expert_group, topk_group (passed as the effective min(topk_group,num_expert_group)), topk, renormalize, routed_scaling_factor=1.0, scoring_func in {0,1}. scores/bias are plain randn so no gen_inputs is needed. Reference calls _custom_ops.grouped_topk and returns its (topk_weights, topk_ids) tuple; the default PyTree comparison validates both elements (test compares weights close and ids exactly). Only valid combos (total_experts % num_expert_group == 0, topk_group <= num_expert_group) are migrated. Requires vLLM at eval time.
